segments.speaker: JANICE
segments.en: Hello ... Flagstone.

segments.speaker: JON
segments.en: Oh hello; is that Flagstone Properties?

segments.speaker: JANICE
segments.en: Yes that’s right. Flagstone here. How can I help you?

segments.speaker: JON
segments.en: Hello. I’m ringing just to make enquiries about renting a house. My name’s Jon Anderson.

segments.speaker: JANICE
segments.en: Yes, Mr Anderson. What sort of thing were you looking for?

segments.speaker: JON
segments.en: Two-bedroomed house with garden.

segments.speaker: JANICE
segments.en: Well. .. yes, sir, that shouldn’t be any problem ... just to let you know that our main areas, the main areas we deal with, are the city centre itself...

segments.speaker: JON
segments.en: City centre ... uh-huh.

segments.speaker: JANICE
segments.en: And the north suburbs.

segments.speaker: JON
segments.en: Oh well... we were most interested in the Northern areas actually.

segments.speaker: JANICE
segments.en: Right... yes... What sort of price were you thinking of?

segments.speaker: JON
segments.en: Well... could you give me some idea?

segments.speaker: JANICE
segments.en: Certainly. It really ranges from £250 per month.

segments.speaker: JON
segments.en: Only £250?

segments.speaker: JANICE
segments.en: Yes, to about £500 depending on a number of different factors.

segments.speaker: JON
segments.en: What does it depend on?

segments.speaker: JANICE
segments.en: Well, obviously the quality of the area. And then whether there’s a garden.

segments.speaker: JON
segments.en: Well, as I said, we’d want a garden.

segments.speaker: JANICE
segments.en: And a garage pushes up the price.

segments.speaker: JON
segments.en: Right... well, we wouldn’t necessarily need one. I think about £350 a month would be our limit.

segments.speaker: JANICE
segments.en: OK. Well.. . would you like to have a look at a couple of properties, sir?

segments.speaker: JON
segments.en: Yes, that’d be great.

segments.speaker: JANICE
segments.en: Looking at our files ... I think we’ve got two which might suit you ...

segments.speaker: JON
segments.en: Hang on. I’ll just get a pen. Right.

segments.speaker: JANICE
segments.en: OK. Well, there’s one on West Park Road which is £325 a month.

segments.speaker: JON
segments.en: Are the bills included?

segments.speaker: JANICE
segments.en: Well, that one just includes the water bill.

segments.speaker: JON
segments.en: OK, right.

segments.speaker: JANICE
segments.en: And the second house is in Tithe Road. I’ll just spell that for you ... OK?

segments.speaker: JON
segments.en: Yep.

segments.speaker: JANICE
segments.en: T-I-T-H-E Road.

segments.speaker: JON
segments.en: Got that. And how much is that one?

segments.speaker: JANICE
segments.en: That’s £380.

segments.speaker: JON
segments.en: 380. Is that including water?

segments.speaker: JANICE
segments.en: No, I’m afraid not, but it does include the telephone rental.

segments.speaker: JON
segments.en: Oh well, that’s not too bad then. So,. ..

segments.speaker: JANICE
segments.en: So, when would you be available to see them?

segments.speaker: JON
segments.en: Well, I’ll be in town next week . . . say . . . Thursday?

segments.speaker: JANICE
segments.en: No, I’m sorry we don’t have any availability for Thursday. How about Wednesday afternoon?

segments.speaker: JON
segments.en: OK. That’s fine. Would 5.00 be OK?

segments.speaker: JANICE
segments.en: Yes, fine. 5.00 it is. Just come to the Flagstone Offices.

segments.speaker: JON
segments.en: Oh, before I forget. What sort of things do I need to get done ... to rent with you?

segments.speaker: JANICE
segments.en: Well, the most important thing is a letter from your bank ...

segments.speaker: JON
segments.en: NO problem . . .

segments.speaker: JANICE
segments.en: And then a reference letter from your employer.

segments.speaker: JON
segments.en: Yes, that’s OK.

segments.speaker: JANICE
segments.en: Great, and then we would need you to give 2 weeks’ notice of moving in ...

segments.speaker: JON
segments.en: Right... 2 weeks’ notice. And what about a deposit?

segments.speaker: JANICE
segments.en: That’s one month’s rent, whatever the amount is.

segments.speaker: JON
segments.en: OK. One month. Is that it?

segments.speaker: JANICE
segments.en: No, sorry, one more . . . you will have to pay for the contract.

segments.speaker: JON
segments.en: Oh yes. I’d forgotten about that. OK, fine. So I’ll start arranging those, and I’ll . . .

segments.speaker: JANICE
segments.en: ... I’ll see you next week.

segments.speaker: JON
segments.en: Yes. Thanks very much. Bye.

segments.speaker: JANICE
segments.en: Goodbye.
